name: Ovex DutyBand Court-Issue Ankle Monitor
description: Matte black polymer housing, 38mm thick, locked to the ankle by a tamper-evident ratchet band in high-visibility yellow. The status light pulses green every four seconds when compliant; amber when near a restricted zone; red when a violation is logged. Ovex manufacturing marks are embossed on the outer face. Impossible to disguise under most pants legs. Designed to be seen — the visibility is the point.
functionality: Continuous GPS tracking with 10-meter precision. BCI-ping broadcasts wearer ID to law enforcement nodes within 50 meters. Tamper detection triggers immediate alert. Battery charged remotely by municipal grid — wearer cannot deactivate. Logs all zone breaches with timestamp.
what_it_says: The system knows exactly where this person is at all times, and everyone around them knows it too.
worn_by: Tier 1 residents on conditional housing agreements
price_range: Φ0 (court-issued) / Φ180–Φ400 (compliance fee billed to wearer monthly)
story_hooks: A fixer claims she can spoof the GPS ping for Φ600 — but three of her last clients disappeared within a week of the job.
The monitor on a Tier 1 resident starts pulsing red inside his own apartment, flagging a zone he's never left — and no one at Ovex will explain why.
A street tech discovers the monitors broadcast on a secondary frequency that no court order authorized — someone is listening to more than location data.

physical_description.visual_profile: A chunky, institutional monitoring device that dominates the ankle with brutal authority. The matte black polymer housing creates a stark, utilitarian silhouette that reads as surveillance technology first, fashion never. The high-visibility yellow ratchet band creates an unavoidable contrast that screams state control. Impossible to ignore or conceal.
physical_description.fit: Locked circumferentially around the ankle with no adjustment once secured. Rigid, immovable, sits approximately 38mm thick. The ratchet band cinches tightly enough to be secure but not so tight as to cause circulation issues—designed for long-term wear, not comfort.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte black polymer housing with embedded circuit traces visible under the surface. High-visibility yellow thermoplastic ratchet band rated for durability and weather resistance. Stainless steel locking mechanism.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, industrial matte finish on the black polymer with subtle embossed Ovex branding. The yellow band has a slightly textured grip surface to prevent slipping. Housing feels cold and hard—deliberately unyielding.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black polymer contrasted aggressively with safety-yellow ratchet band. Status indicators: steady green pulse (compliant), amber (warning zone), red (violation). The yellow is intentionally high-visibility—no color theory, pure function.
physical_description.closures: Tamper-evident ratchet band with locking teeth that only tighten, never loosen. Once secured by enforcement personnel, it requires bolt-cutters or authorized release tools to remove. No user-accessible closures.
distinctive_features: Pulsing status light indicator (green/amber/red) visible every four seconds
Embossed Ovex Compliance Systems branding on outer face
Tamper-evident design—any cutting or forced removal triggers immediate alert
Integrated GPS and biometric monitoring (invisible to wearer)
Rigid polymer construction designed to resist damage and tampering
Yellow band color mandated by GLMZ law enforcement standards
No way to disguise under standard pants—visibility is intentional punishment
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 sub-grade indicator. Wearing this device immediately signals legal entanglement, probation, or custody within GLMZ jurisdiction. A visible marker of state control.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by individuals under legal monitoring—probationers, parolees, detention diversion subjects, or those awaiting trial. Signals that the wearer is monitored, restricted, and operating under state surveillance. Creates immediate social stigma and legal visibility. Marks the wearer as legally compromised.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine and functional—any sign of tampering or damage triggers alerts. The black polymer shows micro-scratches from daily wear but is designed to weather without degradation. The yellow band may fade slightly but remains visible. No patching or repair—this is state property.
